maria_cs: Quick question — mapping latency SLO violations to credit calculations for onboarding customers. Are we aligned on which signal counts: single p95 blips vs sustained p95 > SLA? cc @arjun_sre @tess_pm

arjun_sre: We currently base credits on 5-min windows where p95 > SLA_MS for two consecutive windows. That was in the old playbook but hasn't been enforced consistently. I can paste the query we use.

arjun_sre: ```sql
-- rolling 5m p95 check
SELECT service, window_start,
  approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) AS p95
FROM metrics.latency
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY service, window_start
HAVING p95 > SLA_MS;
```

maria_cs: That helps. In onboarding we see brief p95 blips during traffic ramps. Customers complain if a single short spike triggers a credit. Should we require X minutes above SLA before credit for onboarding cohorts?

tess_pm: My recommendation: require 10 minutes sustained (i.e., two consecutive 5-min windows) for small onboarding customers. For enterprise/new-commit customers, relax to 5 minutes but require a root-cause note and ops approval. Also we should add explicit wording in the onboarding checklist and the customer-facing SLA doc.

oliver_sales: From renewals/renewal-risk POV we need the signal to be explainable in the report. Can we tag events with a noise flag (e.g., autoscale or provisioning spikes) so we can filter out 'onboarding-noise'? Also request a human review step before issuing credits for any account flagged as "high-risk".

arjun_sre: Yep — we can add a noisy_window flag during aggregation by joining the events table. Sketch tweak: join metrics.latency with infra.events and set noisy=true when scale_event_count > 0 in the window.

maria_cs: Action items: arjun -> add noisy flag + example query and add a column `credit_candidate BOOL`; tess -> update CS onboarding checklist and add a short paragraph for customer-facing wording; oliver -> define the human-review workflow & SLA for credit decisions (who approves and turnaround); I'll draft the customer-facing paragraph for comms. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Incident Detector Bot: deployed rolling-p95-rule v1.2 (5m windows, noisy flag join) at 2026-03-21T12:04Z

maria_cs: Thanks — let's reconvene after the queries/docs land and run a quick dry-run on two recent onboarding accounts to validate noise tagging.
